uq_journal_entries_auto_source.name: uq_journal_entries_auto_source
uq_journal_entries_auto_source.where: ((source_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_type = ANY (ARRAY['order_sale'::text, 'order_cogs'::text, 'goods_receipt'::text, 'payroll_run'::text, 'payment_adjustment'::text, 'purchase'::text, 'cash_drawer_entry'::text, 'shift_variance'::text, 'driver_settlement'::text, 'driver_attendance_shift'::text, 'conversion_order'::text, 'stock_count'::text, 'supplier_invoice_variance'::text])) AND (created_at >= '2026-10-02 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))

uq_journal_entries_single_reversal.name: uq_journal_entries_single_reversal
uq_journal_entries_single_reversal.where: ((reversal_of_entry_id IS NOT NULL) AND (created_at >= '2026-10-02 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))

uq_stock_movements_business_effect.name: uq_stock_movements_business_effect
uq_stock_movements_business_effect.where: ((reference_id IS NOT NULL) AND (reference_type = ANY (ARRAY['order'::text, 'order_cancellation'::text, 'conversion_order'::text])) AND (occurred_at >= '2026-10-02 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))

loyalty_rewards_kind_target.name: loyalty_rewards_kind_target
loyalty_rewards_kind_target.value: ((kind = 'discount'::text) AND (discount_amount > (0)::numeric) AND (variant_id IS NULL) AND (combo_id IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'free_item'::text) AND (variant_id IS NOT NULL) AND (combo_id IS NULL) AND (discount_amount IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'free_combo'::text) AND (combo_id IS NOT NULL) AND (variant_id IS NULL) AND (discount_amount IS NULL))

chk_order_items_item_xor_combo.name: chk_order_items_item_xor_combo
chk_order_items_item_xor_combo.value: ((combo_id IS NOT NULL) AND (menu_item_id IS NULL) AND (variant_id IS NULL)) OR ((combo_id IS NULL) AND (menu_item_id IS NOT NULL) AND (variant_id IS NOT NULL))
